function.description: Use when you need to preview a text-like document (md/txt). Two modes: (1) paging — without `keyword`, returns a fixed line window; use `has_more` + next `start_line` to continue. (2) keyword search — with `keyword`, returns ALL paragraphs containing the keyword across the whole file (capped at 20 matches / 8KB total). Prefer keyword mode when looking for an ID/name/term — one call replaces a sequential scan. This is a SAMPLE preview, not full data access. For full-document regex extraction, cross-paragraph aggregation, or structured parsing, use execute_python instead.
function.name: read_doc

keyword.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword. When set, returns ALL paragraphs (blank-line-separated) containing the keyword across the whole file (start_line / line_count are ignored), capped at 20 matches / 8KB total. Prefer this over manual paging when searching for an ID/name/term — one call replaces a sequential scan.

line_count.description: Number of lines to return in this page.

path.description: Relative path to a text document (md/txt/...). Examples: 'knowledge.md', 'docs/readme.txt'. Paths are relative to the task context directory; DO NOT prepend 'context/'. For example use 'knowledge.md' or 'csv/foo.csv', not 'context/knowledge.md'.

start_line.description: 1-based line number to start reading from.
